text: What minimum Charpy or Izod notched impact values at -20°C are required for PP compounds in automotive applications, and which blend compositions have demonstrated compliance?
What dispersed rubber phase particle size range is optimal for effective toughening in PP blends, and how does particle size distribution shift as post-consumer recycled PP content increases?
At what temperature do notched PP blend specimens transition from ductile to brittle fracture, and how does this ductile-to-brittle transition temperature shift as recycled PP content increases?

How does the degree of thermal-oxidative degradation in post-consumer recycled PP affect the mechanical properties of virgin-recycled PP blends, and what characterisation methods are used to assess it?
How does the source of post-consumer recycled PP such as packaging, automotive parts, or mixed consumer streams affect the consistency and mechanical properties of virgin-recycled PP blends?

How does increasing post-consumer recycled PP content affect the melt flow rate of virgin-recycled PP blends, and what compounding strategies are used to compensate for MFR drift in automotive injection moulding grades?

What impact modifier types and approximate concentrations are effective at restoring notched impact strength in PP compounds containing 30-50% post-consumer recycled PP to levels meeting automotive requirements?
What effect does the ratio of virgin impact copolymer to virgin homopolymer PP have on the stiffness-toughness balance when a fixed proportion of post-consumer recycled PP is present in the blend?
How does the crystallinity and crystallisation temperature of polypropylene blends change with increasing recycled PP content, and what effect does this have on stiffness and impact performance?
How does UV or thermal aging affect the mechanical properties and colour of PP compounds containing post-consumer recycled PP, and what stabilisation approaches are reported?
